def commit_action_result(self, committed_intent, prepared_action, observation, comparison, *, owner_id, generation):
        handle = self._opaque(committed_intent, "intent")
        reg = self.registration(handle["registration_id"])
        key, plan = reg["book"], plain(prepared_action["plan"])
        observer = self._observers[key]
        captured, snapshot = self.capture_observation(observation, observer, reg["id"])
        classification, outcome, platform_ids, reason = self._comparison(comparison)
        with self.effect_gate(handle["target_key"]).acquire(), self.transaction() as connection:
            self._lease(connection, key, owner_id, generation, pending_ok=True)
            intent = connection.execute("SELECT * FROM intents WHERE id=?", (handle["id"],)).fetchone()
            plan_row = connection.execute("SELECT * FROM plans WHERE id=?", (intent["plan"],)).fetchone()
            if intent["owner"] != owner_id or intent["generation"] != generation or intent["state"] != "PENDING" or plan_row["status"] != "RUNNING":
                fail("PLAN_INTERRUPTED", "original current RUNNING intent required")
            self._verify_intent_prepared(intent, plan_row, prepared_action=prepared_action)
            from annotation.delivery.mock import compare_action
            original_before = self.read_resource(handle["artifact"]["payload"]["prepared_before"], reg["id"])
            checked = self._comparison(compare_action(prepared_action["action"], original_before, observation))
            if checked[:3] != (classification, outcome, platform_ids):
                fail("OBSERVATION_BINDING_MISMATCH", "caller comparison differs from public comparator")
            if observation["observed_at"] <= handle["artifact"]["payload"]["intent_committed_at"]:
                fail("OBSERVATION_NOT_FRESH", "result read predates committed intent")
            if snapshot:
                self._append(connection, reg["id"], snapshot)
            prepared = handle["artifact"]["payload"]["prepared_before"]
            before_id = self._evidence(connection, reg["id"], prepared)
            after_id = self._evidence(connection, reg["id"], captured["readback"])
            result = {"action_id": intent["action"], "outcome": outcome, "platform_ids": platform_ids,
                "before_evidence_refs": [before_id], "after_evidence_refs": [after_id], "readback": captured["readback"],
                "effect_match": "INDETERMINATE" if outcome == "UNKNOWN" else classification,
                "next_step": {"APPLIED": "POSTCHECK", "NOT_APPLIED": "RECHECK_TARGET", "UNKNOWN": "RECONCILE"}[outcome],
                "replay_allowed": False, "reason": classification + ": " + str(reason), "attempt_fact": "MAY_HAVE_BEEN_ATTEMPTED" if outcome == "UNKNOWN" else "ATTEMPTED",
                "attempt_evidence_refs": [captured["resource"]], "intent_ref": handle["intent_ref"]}
            fact, resource = self._fact(connection, reg, plan, intent["action"], result, intent=intent,
                prepared=prepared, snapshot_ref=reference(snapshot) if snapshot else None, readback=captured["resource"])
            connection.execute("UPDATE actions SET state=?,fact=? WHERE book=? AND id=?", (outcome, canonical(resource).decode(), key, intent["action"]))
            connection.execute("UPDATE intents SET state=? WHERE id=?", ("PENDING" if outcome == "UNKNOWN" else outcome, intent["id"]))
            if outcome == "APPLIED":
                connection.execute("UPDATE plans SET cursor=cursor+1 WHERE id=?", (intent["plan"],))
            else:
                connection.execute("UPDATE plans SET status='INTERRUPTED' WHERE id=?", (intent["plan"],))
            event = self._event(connection, key, "ACTION_RESULT_COMMITTED", {"plan_ref": reference(plan),
                "action_id": intent["action"], "action_digest": fact["action_digest"], "intent_ref": handle["intent_ref"],
                "obligation_id": intent["obligation"], "fact": resource, "outcome": outcome,
                "plan_state": "INTERRUPTED" if outcome != "APPLIED" else "RUNNING"})
        projection = self.project_plan(reg["id"], plan)
        if projection["receipt_ref"] is not None:
            self.fault("AFTER_RECEIPT_COMMIT")
        return Handle(fact=resource, event=event, result=result, progress=projection)

def _project_plan_locked(self, registration_id, plan=None):
        reg, plan = self.registration(registration_id), plan or self._plan(registration_id)
        plan_id = digest(reference(plan))
        with self.transaction() as connection:
            rows = connection.execute("SELECT * FROM actions WHERE plan=? ORDER BY position", (plan_id,)).fetchall()
            if not rows:
                return {"actions": [], "state": "NO_ACTIONS"}
            bundle = self.bundle(registration_id)
            dependencies = [a for a in bundle["artifacts"] if a["book_id"] == plan["book_id"] and a["scope_id"] == plan["scope_id"]]
            receipt = None
            if all(row["fact"] for row in rows):
                resources = [json.loads(row["fact"]) for row in rows]
                facts = [self.read_resource(r, registration_id) for r in resources]
                unknown = [f for f in facts if f["result"]["outcome"] == "UNKNOWN"]
                issues = [{"issue_id": "issue-save-unknown-" + digest(f)[:32], "code": "SAVE_UNKNOWN",
                    "scope_type": "action", "scope_id": f["action_id"],
                    "evidence_refs": f["result"]["after_evidence_refs"] or f["result"]["before_evidence_refs"],
                    "severity": "blocking", "blocks": ["APPLY", "COMPLETE"],
                    "suggested_strategy": {"strategy_id": "RECONCILE", "max_attempts": 0, "max_cost": 0.0},
                    "reason": "Actual controlled read did not establish this action's effect; retain original UNKNOWN"}
                    for f in unknown]
                payload = {"plan": reference(plan), "execution_mode": "SIMULATED", "results": [f["result"] for f in facts],
                    "action_fact_refs": resources, "unresolved_issue_ids": [i["issue_id"] for i in issues],
                    "write_disposition": "PAUSE_RECONCILE" if any(f["result"]["outcome"] == "UNKNOWN" for f in facts) else "POSTCHECK" if all(f["result"]["outcome"] == "APPLIED" for f in facts) else "RECHECK_TARGET"}
                receipt = next((a for a in dependencies if a["kind"] == "ExecutionReceipt"
                    and a["payload"]["plan"] == reference(plan) and a["payload"].get("action_fact_refs") == resources), None)
                if receipt is None:
                    receipt = self._new_artifact(plan, "ExecutionReceipt", payload, dependencies)
                    self._append(connection, registration_id, receipt)
                    dependencies.append(receipt)
                    if issues:
                        pre = next(a for a in dependencies if reference(a) == plan["payload"]["precheck"])
                        proof = list(dict.fromkeys(e for i in issues for e in i["evidence_refs"]))
                        post = self._new_artifact(plan, "CheckReport", {"stage": "POST_APPLY",
                            "subject": reference(receipt), "graph": plan["payload"]["graph"],
                            "policy": plan["payload"]["policy"], "snapshot": facts[-1]["observed_snapshot_ref"],
                            "receipt": reference(receipt), "coverage": pre["payload"]["coverage"],
                            "checks": [{"check_id": name, "outcome": "UNAVAILABLE", "evidence_refs": proof,
                                "reason": "Original save result remains UNKNOWN"} for name in ("frame_structure", "final_content")],
                            "issues": issues, "decision": "HOLD", "reason": "Actual UNKNOWN facts require read-only reconciliation",
                            "recovery_refs": []}, dependencies)
                        self._append(connection, registration_id, post)
                        dependencies.append(post)
                for row in rows:
                    if row["intent"]:
                        connection.execute("UPDATE intents SET receipt=? WHERE id=? AND receipt IS NULL", (canonical(reference(receipt)).decode(), row["intent"]))
            book = connection.execute("SELECT * FROM books WHERE key=?", (reg["book"],)).fetchone()
            items = []
            for row in rows:
                intent = connection.execute("SELECT * FROM intents WHERE id=?", (row["intent"],)).fetchone() if row["intent"] else None
                resolution = connection.execute("SELECT * FROM resolutions WHERE intent=? ORDER BY rowid DESC LIMIT 1", (row["intent"],)).fetchone() if row["intent"] else None
                intent_ref = json.loads(intent['ref']) if intent else None
                material = self.read_resource(json.loads(row['fact']), registration_id) if row['fact'] is not None else None
                attempt_fact, attempt_evidence = self._progress_attempt(row, intent_ref, reference(plan), material)
                effective = {"RESOLVED_APPLIED": "APPLIED", "RESOLVED_NOT_APPLIED": "NOT_APPLIED"}.get(resolution["outcome"] if resolution else "", row["state"] if row["state"] in ("APPLIED", "NOT_APPLIED") else "UNDETERMINED" if not intent else "UNKNOWN")
                items.append({"action_id": row["id"], "intent_ref": json.loads(intent["ref"]) if intent else None,
                    "attempt_fact": attempt_fact,
                    "dependency_status": "SATISFIED" if row["position"] == 0 or all(x["state"] == "APPLIED" for x in rows[:row["position"]]) else "BLOCKED",
                    "attempt_evidence_refs": attempt_evidence, "receipt_ref": reference(receipt) if receipt else json.loads(intent["receipt"]) if intent and intent["receipt"] else None,
                    "resolution_head_ref": json.loads(resolution["ref"]) if resolution else None, "effective_outcome": effective,
                    "result_fact": json.loads(row["fact"]) if row["fact"] else None})
            progress = self._new_artifact(plan, "ExecutionProgress", {"plan_ref": reference(plan), "journal_id": book["journal"],
                "journal_head_sequence": book["head_sequence"], "journal_head_hash": book["head_hash"], "actions": items}, dependencies)
            self._append(connection, registration_id, progress)
            if all(row["state"] == "APPLIED" for row in rows):
                connection.execute("UPDATE plans SET status='FINISHED' WHERE id=?", (plan_id,))
        return {"progress_ref": reference(progress), "receipt_ref": reference(receipt) if receipt else None, "actions": items}

RuntimeStore._new_artifact.source:
def _new_artifact(self, plan, kind, payload, dependencies, artifact_id=None):
        value = {key: copy.deepcopy(plan[key]) for key in
            ("schema_version", "run_id", "book_id", "scope_id", "producer")}
        value.update(artifact_id=artifact_id or unique(kind.lower()), revision=1, kind=kind,
            payload=plain(payload), input_refs=list({canonical(reference(a)): reference(a) for a in dependencies}.values()), created_at=now())
        value["producer"].update(module="a03-runtime", implementation_version="a03-p2")
        value["content_hash"] = digest(value)
        return value

RuntimeStore.transaction.source:
def transaction(self):
        connection = self.connect()
        try:
            connection.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
            yield connection
            connection.commit()
        except sqlite3.Error as error:
            connection.rollback()
            fail("STORAGE_TRANSACTION_FAILED", str(error), 5)
        except BaseException:
            connection.rollback()
            raise
        finally:
            connection.close()

def _issue_context(registry, bundle, asset_root, *, binding='', historical=False):
    entry = _REGISTRIES.get(id(registry))
    need(entry is not None and entry[0] is registry, 'NATIVE_REGISTRY_REQUIRED', '$registry')
    root = Path(asset_root).resolve(strict=True)
    data, manifest = _validate_value(bundle, root)
    context = BridgeContext(select_native_codec(), root, digest(data), manifest, registry, binding, historical)
    _CONTEXTS[id(context)] = context
    return context

module._validate_value.source:
def _validate_value(bundle, root):
    data = copy_json(bundle.model_dump() if hasattr(bundle, 'model_dump') else bundle)
    need(type(data) is dict and data.get('format_version') == EXCHANGE, 'NATIVE_VERSION_REQUIRED', '$')
    need(all(a.get('schema_version') == VERSION for a in data.get('artifacts', [])), 'NATIVE_VERSION_REQUIRED', '$artifacts')
    reader = ResourceReader(root)
    package = StaticPackage(data, reader, _documents(), set(_document('api.json')['registry']))
    package.validate()
    # Retain 1.1's synthetic-origin, timestamp, source proof, intent, resolution,
    # fact, progress and unchanged C01 geometry/business invariants as well.
    from .. import recovery
    ctx = recovery._Closure(data, root, schema_version=VERSION)
    ctx.schemas = NativeSchemas()
    ctx.native = True
    ctx.check()
    recovery._scope(ctx)
    for artifact in data['artifacts']:
        recovery._timestamp(artifact['created_at'])
    recovery._intents(ctx)
    heads = recovery._resolutions(ctx)
    recovery._receipts_progress(ctx, heads)
    recovery._legacy_projection(ctx)
    _reports(ctx, heads)
    return data, tuple(sorted(reader.consumed.items()))

def validate_native_bundle(bundle, *, bridge_context, asset_root=None):
    require_context(bridge_context, bundle)
    root = Path(asset_root).resolve() if asset_root is not None else bridge_context.asset_root
    need(root == bridge_context.asset_root, 'NATIVE_ROOT_MISMATCH', '$asset_root')
    data, manifest = _validate_value(bundle, root)
    need(manifest == bridge_context.resource_manifest, 'NATIVE_RESOURCE_MANIFEST', '$resources')
    return NativeBundle(data, bridge_context)

module._reports.source:
def _reports(ctx, heads):
    """Native reports consume an independent report read and immutable heads."""
    from .. import recovery
    for artifact in ctx.artifacts.values():
        payload = artifact['payload']
        if artifact['kind'] == 'CheckReport' and payload['stage'] == 'POST_APPLY':
            receipt = ctx.resolve(payload['receipt'], artifact, 'ExecutionReceipt')
            plan = ctx.resolve(receipt['payload']['plan'], artifact, 'ApplyPlan')
            snapshot = ctx.resolve(payload['report_snapshot_ref'], artifact, 'PlatformSnapshot')
            need(payload['subject'] == payload['receipt']
                 and payload['graph'] == plan['payload']['graph'] and payload['policy'] == plan['payload']['policy'],
                 'NATIVE_REPORT_BINDING', artifact['artifact_id'])
            need([b['action_id'] for b in payload['action_bindings']] == [a['action_id'] for a in plan['payload']['actions']],
                 'NATIVE_REPORT_ACTION_COVERAGE', artifact['artifact_id'])
            _, observation = ctx.resource(payload['report_observation'])
            need(observation['target_state_hash'] == snapshot['payload']['observed_hash']
                 and observation['target_state_version'] == snapshot['payload']['observed_version'],
                 'NATIVE_REPORT_READ_BINDING', artifact['artifact_id'])
            effective = {r['action_id']: r['outcome'] for r in receipt['payload']['results']}
            from annotation.delivery.planner import compare_action_effect
            comparisons = []
            for action, binding, fact_ref in zip(plan['payload']['actions'], payload['action_bindings'], receipt['payload']['action_fact_refs']):
                fact = recovery._fact(ctx, fact_ref, artifact)
                need(binding['action_digest'] == digest(action) and binding['fact_ref'] == fact_ref
                     and binding['intent_ref'] == fact['intent_ref']
                     and binding['resolution_head_ref'] == fact['resolution_ref']
                     and binding['observed_snapshot_ref'] == fact['observed_snapshot_ref']
                     and binding['effective_outcome'] == fact['result']['outcome'],
                     'NATIVE_REPORT_FACT_BINDING', artifact['artifact_id'])
                _, before = ctx.resource(fact['prepared_before'])
                comparisons.append(compare_action_effect(action, before, observation))
            need(payload['frame_structure'] == ('PASS' if all(c['effect_match'] == 'MATCH' for c in comparisons) else 'FAIL'),
                 'NATIVE_REPORT_FRAME_COMPARISON', artifact['artifact_id'])
            for ref in payload['recovery_refs']:
                head = ctx.resolve(ref, artifact, 'ReconciliationResult')
                hp = head['payload']
                recovery._consumer_resolution_head(ctx, artifact, ref, heads, intent_ref=hp['intent_ref'],
                    plan_ref=receipt['payload']['plan'], action_id=hp['action_id'])
                if hp['original_receipt_ref'] is None:
                    matches = [ctx.resource(r)[1] for r in receipt['payload']['action_fact_refs']]
                    need(any(f['intent_ref'] == hp['intent_ref'] and f['resolution_ref'] == ref for f in matches),
                         'NATIVE_LATE_RECEIPT_BINDING', artifact['artifact_id'])
                else:
                    need(hp['original_receipt_ref'] == payload['receipt'], 'NATIVE_ORIGINAL_RECEIPT', artifact['artifact_id'])
                need(recovery._timestamp(snapshot['payload']['observed_at']) > recovery._timestamp(hp['observed_at']),
                     'NATIVE_REPORT_READ_NOT_FRESH', artifact['artifact_id'])
                effective[hp['action_id']] = {'RESOLVED_APPLIED': 'APPLIED', 'RESOLVED_NOT_APPLIED': 'NOT_APPLIED', 'STILL_UNKNOWN': 'UNKNOWN'}[hp['resolution']]
            need(payload['decision'] != 'PASS' or all(v == 'APPLIED' for v in effective.values()),
                 'UNPROVEN_APPLY', artifact['artifact_id'])
        if artifact['kind'] == 'BatchReport':
            source = ctx.resolve(payload['source'], artifact, 'SourceBundle')
            post = ctx.resolve(payload['postcheck'], artifact, 'CheckReport')['payload']
            need(payload['receipt'] == post['receipt'] and payload['graph'] == post['graph']
                 and payload['report_snapshot_ref'] == post['report_snapshot_ref']
                 and payload['recovery_refs'] == post['recovery_refs'], 'NATIVE_BATCH_BINDING', artifact['artifact_id'])
            need(payload['scope_manifest'] == source['payload']['scope_manifest']
                 and payload['total_expected'] == len(payload['scope_manifest'])
                 and [q['question_id'] for q in payload['questions']] == payload['scope_manifest'],
                 'DENOMINATOR_CHANGED', artifact['artifact_id'])
            need(payload['content_check_status'] == 'PENDING' and payload['submission_status'] == 'NOT_SUBMITTED',
                 'COMPLETION_GUARD', artifact['artifact_id'])

module.select_native_codec.source:
def select_native_codec():
    profile = _document('profile.json')
    for path, expected in profile['schema_pins']:
        need(hashlib.sha256(_data(path)).hexdigest() == expected, 'NATIVE_SCHEMA_PIN', path)
    for path, expected in profile['implementation_pins']:
        location = resources.files('annotation').joinpath(path[len('@annotation/'):]) if path.startswith('@annotation/') else resources.files(__package__).joinpath(path)
        need(hashlib.sha256(location.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == expected,
             'NATIVE_IMPLEMENTATION_PIN', path)
    for key, filename in (('api_sha256', 'api.json'), ('interface_sha256', 'interface-source.json'),
                          ('oracle_sha256', 'oracle.json')):
        need(profile[key] == hashlib.sha256(_data(filename)).hexdigest(), 'NATIVE_PROFILE_PIN', filename)
    adoption = _document('adoption.json')
    profile_sha = hashlib.sha256(_data('profile.json')).hexdigest()
    need(adoption['profile_sha256'] == profile_sha and adoption['scope'] == 'A_INTERNAL_FIXED_SYNTHETIC_ONLY',
         'NATIVE_ADOPTION_PIN', 'adoption.json')
    return BridgeSelection('a03-native-1', 'CURRENT', EXCHANGE, VERSION, PROFILE, profile_sha,
        tuple(tuple(row) for row in profile['schema_pins']), profile['api_sha256'], profile['interface_sha256'],
        profile['oracle_sha256'], profile['verifier_sha256'], tuple(tuple(row) for row in profile['implementation_pins']),
        hashlib.sha256(_data('adoption.json')).hexdigest())

def check(self, value, name='recovery-exchange.schema.json', definition=None):

        key = {'action-fact.schema.json': 'fact', 'event-prefix.schema.json': 'prefix',
               'unattempted-basis.schema.json': 'basis'}.get(name, 'exchange')

        node = document['$defs']['Amended' + definition] if definition else document
        schema_validate(value, node, document)

StaticPackage.validate.source:
def validate(self):
        validate(self.bundle, self.documents["exchange"])
        self.index = {digest(artifact_ref(a)): a for a in self.bundle["artifacts"]}
        need(len(self.index) == len(self.bundle["artifacts"]), "DUPLICATE_REF", "$")
        need(len({(a["artifact_id"], a["revision"]) for a in self.bundle["artifacts"]}) == len(self.bundle["artifacts"]), "DUPLICATE_ID", "$")
        for i, record in enumerate(self.bundle["evidence"]):
            key = record["evidence_id"]
            need(key not in self.evidence_index, "EVIDENCE_ID_DUPLICATE", "evidence/" + str(i) + "/" + key)
            self.evidence_index[key] = record
        for artifact in self.bundle["artifacts"]:
            need(artifact["kind"] in self.registry, "UNREGISTERED_KIND", artifact["artifact_id"])
            need(artifact["schema_version"] in (VERSION,), "VERSION_SELECTOR", artifact["artifact_id"])
            self.consumer("A:" + digest(artifact_ref(artifact)), artifact["payload"], artifact["book_id"], artifact["scope_id"], artifact["input_refs"], artifact["artifact_id"])
        for record in self.bundle["evidence"]:
            self.scan(record["resource"], "E:" + record["evidence_id"], None, None, {}, "evidence/" + record["evidence_id"], set(), False)
        self.stages.append("MIXED_DAG")
        active, done = set(), set()

        def visit(node):
            need(node not in active, "MIXED_CYCLE", node)
            if node in done:
                return
            active.add(node)
            for child in self.edges.get(node, ()):
                visit(child)
            active.remove(node)
            done.add(node)

        for node in list(self.edges):
            visit(node)
        self.stages.append("CONSUMER_DECLARATIONS_BOOK_SCOPE")
        for found, declared, book, scope, path in self.consumers:
            need(set(found) <= set(declared), "UNDECLARED_REFERENCE", path)
            for reference in declared.values():
                target = self.artifact(reference, path)
                need(target["book_id"] == book, "FOREIGN_BOOK", path)
                need(target["scope_id"] == scope, "ORDINARY_SCOPE", path)
        self.stages.append("ARTIFACT_HASH_AND_PRE_STATIC_TAIL")
        for artifact in self.bundle["artifacts"]:
            need(digest({key: value for key, value in artifact.items() if key != "content_hash"}) == artifact["content_hash"], "ARTIFACT_HASH", artifact["artifact_id"])
            if artifact["schema_version"] == VERSION and artifact["kind"] == "CheckReport" and artifact["payload"]["stage"] == "PRE_APPLY":
                run = self.reader.read(artifact["payload"]["synthetic_run_ref"])
                validate(run, self.documents["pre_run"])
                need(run["context"] == artifact["payload"]["verification_context"], "PRE_CONTEXT", artifact["artifact_id"])
                need(run["graph_ref"] == artifact["payload"]["graph"] and run["admission"] == "RUNTIME_RECHECK_REQUIRED" and run["snapshot_ref"] == artifact["payload"]["snapshot"], "PRE_BINDING", artifact["artifact_id"])
        self.stages.append("COMPLETE_STATIC_RETURN")
        return self

module.publish_native_quality.source:
def publish_native_quality(store, registration_id, projection=None, *, owner_id=None, generation=None):
    from . import open_observer, claim_current
    reg = store.registration(registration_id)
    key = store.target_key(registration_id)
    borrowed = owner_id is not None or generation is not None
    if borrowed:
        if owner_id is None or generation is None:
            fail('OWNER_GENERATION_STALE', 'report owner_id and generation must be supplied together', 4)
        # Use the existing instance/PID/ACTIVE/owner/generation/expiry guard.
        # Validate before projecting or consuming the durable report read.
        with store.connect() as connection:
            store._lease(connection, reg['book'], owner_id, generation, pending_ok=True)
    plan = store._plan(registration_id)
    projection = projection or store.project_plan(registration_id, plan)
    if projection.get('receipt_ref') is None:
        return Handle(status='NO_COMPLETE_RECEIPT', content_check_status='PENDING', submission_status='NOT_SUBMITTED')
    observer = open_observer(store, registration_id)
    claim = Handle(owner_id=owner_id, generation=generation) if borrowed else claim_current(store, observer, key)
    try:
        with store.transaction() as connection:
            store._lease(connection, reg['book'], claim['owner_id'], claim['generation'], pending_ok=True)
            connection.execute('INSERT INTO native_report_reads VALUES(?,?,1)', (digest(reference(plan)), time.time()))
        actual = observe_bounded(observer, timeout=2)
        if not actual.get('ok') or actual['read_elapsed_seconds'] > 2:
            fail('NATIVE_REPORT_READ_FAILED', 'durable report read consumed; no implicit retry')
        captured, snapshot = store.capture_observation(actual['observation'], observer, registration_id)
        if snapshot is None:
            fail('NATIVE_REPORT_READ_INCOMPLETE')
        with store.transaction() as connection:
            store._lease(connection, reg['book'], claim['owner_id'], claim['generation'], pending_ok=True)
            store._append(connection, registration_id, snapshot)
        bundle = store._validate(store.bundle(registration_id), asset_root=reg['package_root'])
        receipt = resolve_artifact(bundle, projection['receipt_ref'], 'ExecutionReceipt')
        graph = resolve_artifact(bundle, plan['payload']['graph'], 'QuestionGraph')
        bindings, heads, comparisons = [], [], []
        for action, resource in zip(plan['payload']['actions'], receipt.payload.action_fact_refs):
            fact = store.read_resource(plain(resource), registration_id)
            before = store.read_resource(fact['prepared_before'], registration_id)
            comparison = compare_action_effect(action, before, actual['observation'])
            comparisons.append(comparison)
            head = resolve_artifact(bundle, fact['resolution_ref'], 'ReconciliationResult') if fact['resolution_ref'] else None
            if head:
                heads.append(artifact_ref(head))
            bindings.append({'action_id': action['action_id'], 'action_digest': digest(action),
                'intent_ref': fact['intent_ref'], 'fact_ref': plain(resource),
                'resolution_head_ref': artifact_ref(head) if head else None,
                'head_original_receipt_ref': plain(head.payload.original_receipt_ref) if head else None,
                'observed_snapshot_ref': fact['observed_snapshot_ref'], 'effective_outcome': fact['result']['outcome']})
        frame_pass = all(c['effect_match'] == 'MATCH' for c in comparisons)
        payload = {'stage': 'POST_APPLY', 'subject': artifact_ref(receipt), 'graph': plan['payload']['graph'],
            'policy': plan['payload']['policy'], 'receipt': artifact_ref(receipt), 'report_snapshot_ref': reference(snapshot),
            'report_observation': captured['resource'], 'action_bindings': bindings, 'recovery_refs': heads,
            'frame_structure': 'PASS' if frame_pass else 'FAIL', 'content_check_status': 'PENDING',
            'submission_status': 'NOT_SUBMITTED', 'decision': 'HOLD', 'issues': ['CONTENT_REVIEW_PENDING']}
        post = make_artifact('CheckReport', unique('native-post'), graph, payload, list(bundle.artifacts),
            graph.producer.config_version, 'a03-native-independent-report', now(), bridge_context=bundle.bridge_context)
        bundle = append_artifacts(bundle, post, bridge_context=bundle.bridge_context)
        source = resolve_artifact(bundle, graph.payload.source, 'SourceBundle')
        batch_payload = {'source': artifact_ref(source), 'graph': artifact_ref(graph), 'receipt': artifact_ref(receipt),
            'postcheck': artifact_ref(post), 'report_snapshot_ref': reference(snapshot), 'recovery_refs': heads,
            'scope_manifest': list(source.payload.scope_manifest), 'total_expected': len(source.payload.scope_manifest),
            'questions': [{'question_id': q, 'state': 'PENDING'} for q in source.payload.scope_manifest],
            'state': 'CONTENT_PENDING', 'content_check_status': 'PENDING', 'submission_status': 'NOT_SUBMITTED'}
        batch = make_artifact('BatchReport', unique('native-batch'), graph, batch_payload, list(bundle.artifacts),
            graph.producer.config_version, 'a03-native-independent-report', now(), bridge_context=bundle.bridge_context)
        bundle = append_artifacts(bundle, batch, bridge_context=bundle.bridge_context)
        with store.effect_gate(key).acquire(), store.transaction() as connection:
            store._lease(connection, reg['book'], claim['owner_id'], claim['generation'], pending_ok=True)
            store._append(connection, registration_id, post, batch)
        return Handle(postcheck_ref=artifact_ref(post), batch_ref=artifact_ref(batch), frame_structure=payload['frame_structure'],
            content_check_status='PENDING', submission_status='NOT_SUBMITTED')
    finally:
        if not borrowed:
            store.release(key, owner_id=claim['owner_id'], generation=claim['generation'])

module.compare_action_effect.source:
def compare_action_effect(action, before_observation, after_observation, *, comparator_version="a02-facts-1"):
    """Pure A02 comparison; transport responses never determine an outcome.

    Recovery observations additionally require full scope and unique platform IDs.
    Legacy observations retain their original representation and outcome rules.
    """
    if comparator_version != "a02-facts-1":
        reject("COMPARATOR_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED", "unsupported shared action comparator")
    action = _plain(action)
    before, after = _plain(before_observation), _plain(after_observation)
    digest = content_digest(action)
    recovery = "observation_id" in after
    result = PublicRecord(comparator_version=comparator_version, action_id=action["action_id"],
                          action_digest=digest, platform_ids=[], effect_match="INDETERMINATE",
                          outcome="UNKNOWN", identity_checks={}, reasons=[],
                          expected_effect_digest=content_digest(action["expected_after"]),
                          actual_digest=None, relevant_scope_completeness=False,
                          before_observation_ref=before.get("resource"),
                          after_observation_ref=after.get("resource"),
                          before_read_sequence=before.get("read_sequence"),
                          after_read_sequence=after.get("read_sequence"))
    def finish(match, ids, reason):
        result.update(effect_match=match, platform_ids=ids, reasons=[reason], reason=reason,
                      outcome={"MATCH": "APPLIED", "ABSENT": "NOT_APPLIED"}.get(match, "UNKNOWN"))
        return result
    if after.get("read_status", "OK") != "OK":
        return finish("INDETERMINATE", [], "readback unavailable, contradictory or truncated")
    if recovery:
        fields = ("store_id", "target_session_id", "target_key", "scope_id", "source_ref")
        checks = {name: before.get(name) == after.get(name) and name in before for name in fields}
        checks["action_target"] = after.get("target_key", {}).get("target_id") == action["target"]["target_id"]
        result["identity_checks"] = checks
        if not all(checks.values()):
            reject("OBSERVATION_BINDING_MISMATCH", "before/after observation identity differs")
        if (not isinstance(after.get("read_sequence"), int) or
                not isinstance(before.get("read_sequence"), int) or
                after["read_sequence"] <= before["read_sequence"]):
            reject("OBSERVATION_NOT_FRESH", "comparison needs a new actual monotonic target read")
        if not before.get("relevant_scope_completeness", before.get("scope_complete", False)) or not after.get("relevant_scope_completeness", after.get("scope_complete", False)):
            return finish("INDETERMINATE", [], "independent relevant scope is incomplete")
    result["relevant_scope_completeness"] = True
    oldview, view = _view(before), _view(after)
    if not isinstance(view, dict) or not all(k in view for k in ("target", "internal_bindings", "frame_projections")):
        return finish("INDETERMINATE", [], "target view is missing")
    questions, allframes = view["target"]["questions"], view["target"]["frames"]
    if recovery and (len({q["platform_question_id"] for q in questions}) != len(questions) or
                     len({f["platform_frame_id"] for f in allframes}) != len(allframes)):
        return finish("CONFLICT", [], "duplicate platform identity")
    if recovery:
        from annotation.contracts import target_state_digest
        if (target_state_digest(oldview) != before.get("target_state_hash") or
                target_state_digest(view) != after.get("target_state_hash")):
            reject("OBSERVATION_BINDING_MISMATCH", "independent business-state digest differs from observation")
    pid = action["target"]["platform_question_id"] or view["internal_bindings"].get(action["target"]["question_id"])
    question = next((q for q in questions if q["platform_question_id"] == pid), None)
    frames = [f for f in allframes if f["platform_question_id"] == pid] if question else []
    projected = [view["frame_projections"].get(f["platform_frame_id"]) for f in frames]
    expected = action["expected_after"]
    result["actual_digest"] = content_digest({"question": question, "frames": frames, "projections": projected})
    if (question and question["directory_id"] == expected["directory_id"] and
            question["platform_order"] == expected["platform_order"] and
            encoded(projected) == expected["frames"] and frames and
            all(p is not None and f["box"] == p["box"] and f["platform_role"] == p["platform_role"]
                for f, p in zip(frames, projected))):
        return finish("MATCH", [pid] + [f["platform_frame_id"] for f in frames],
                      "independent target readback matches all projected frames")
    facts_before, facts_after = action_facts(action, oldview), action_facts(action, view)
    if facts_after == facts_before and facts_after["frame_count"] == 0:
        return finish("ABSENT", [], "explicit readback proves projected frames ABSENT and relevant target unchanged")
    return finish("CONFLICT", [], "effect is partial, changed, or lacks a provable ABSENT baseline")

module.apply_synthetic_action.source:
def apply_synthetic_action(state, action, partial=False):
    payload = state["target"]
    pid = action["target"]["platform_question_id"]
    if pid is None:
        number = len(payload["questions"]) + 1
        existing = {q["platform_question_id"] for q in payload["questions"]}
        while "mock-question-" + str(number) in existing:
            number += 1
        pid = "mock-question-" + str(number)
        directory = action["expected_before"]["directory_id"]
        order = max([q["platform_order"] for q in payload["questions"] if q["directory_id"] == directory] + [0]) + 1
        payload["questions"].append({"platform_question_id": pid, "directory_id": directory, "platform_order": order})
    state["internal_bindings"][action["target"]["question_id"]] = pid
    projected = json.loads(action["expected_after"]["frames"])
    if partial:
        projected = projected[:-1]
    for frame in projected:
        number = len(payload["frames"]) + 1
        existing = {f["platform_frame_id"] for f in payload["frames"]}
        while "mock-frame-" + str(number) in existing:
            number += 1
        fid = "mock-frame-" + str(number)
        payload["frames"].append({"platform_frame_id": fid, "platform_question_id": pid,
                                  "box": frame["box"], "platform_role": frame["platform_role"]})
        state["frame_projections"][fid] = copy.deepcopy(frame)
    state["epoch"] += 1
    return pid

PersistentMockSession.dispatch_action.source:
def dispatch_action(self, prepared_action, *, committed_intent, dispatch_permit, authority, effect_fault=None):
        if effect_fault not in EFFECT_FAULTS:
            reject("INVALID_FAULT", "unsupported synthetic target effect fault")
        prepared = prepared_action
        self._key(prepared["target_key"])
        if committed_intent is None:
            reject("LOCAL_INTENT_COMMIT_REQUIRED", "target requires genuinely committed runtime intent")
        with authority.effect_gate(prepared["target_key"]) as gate:
            checked = self.verify_prepared_action(prepared)
            authorization = authority.consume_first_dispatch(dispatch_permit, effect_gate=gate,
                                  prepared_action=prepared, target_store_id=self.descriptor.store_id,
                                  target_session_id=self.descriptor.target_session_id)
            generation = _get(authorization, "generation")
            owner = _get(authorization, "owner_id")
            authority.verify_target_authorization(authorization, effect_gate=gate,
                target_key=prepared["target_key"], target_store_id=self.descriptor.store_id,
                target_session_id=self.descriptor.target_session_id, generation=generation,
                action_digest=prepared["action_digest"])
            with self._connect() as db:
                db.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
                state = self._load(db)
                if state["fence_generation"] != generation or state["fence_owner_id"] != owner:
                    reject("OWNER_GENERATION_STALE", "independent target fence differs")
                if (self._hash(state) != checked.target_state_hash or
                        "a03-target-epoch-" + str(state["epoch"]) != checked.target_state_version):
                    reject("TARGET_CHANGED", "complete business state changed after actual preparation")
                if action_facts(prepared["action"], self._view(state)) != _plain(prepared["action"])["expected_before"]:
                    reject("TARGET_CHANGED", "target relevant precondition changed before effect")
                action = _plain(prepared["action"])
                if content_digest(action) != prepared["action_digest"]:
                    reject("ACTION_DIGEST_MISMATCH", "prepared action digest changed")
                pid = None
                if effect_fault != "not_applied":
                    pid = apply_synthetic_action(state, action, effect_fault == "partial")
                log = {"origin": "SYNTHETIC", "execution_mode": "SIMULATED", "action_id": prepared["action_id"],
                       "action_digest": prepared["action_digest"], "plan_ref": prepared["plan_ref"],
                       "target_key": prepared["target_key"], "target_session_id": self.descriptor.target_session_id,
                       "owner_id": owner, "generation": generation, "epoch": state["epoch"],
                       "effect_fault": effect_fault or "applied", "mutated": effect_fault != "not_applied",
                       "recorded_at": _utc(), "target_state_hash": self._hash(state)}
                cursor = db.execute("INSERT INTO effects(body) VALUES(?)", (encoded(log),))
                self._save(db, state)
                log["sequence"] = cursor.lastrowid
            if hasattr(authority, "fault"):
                authority.fault("after_effect")
            if effect_fault == "after_effect_exit":
                os._exit(87)
            response = "TIMEOUT" if effect_fault in ("lost_response", "response_lost_readable") else "REJECTED" if effect_fault == "not_applied" else "OK"
            return PublicRecord(status=response, transport_response={"status": response, "platform_question_id": pid},
                                effect_log_ref=log, target_effect_committed=True,
                                outcome="UNKNOWN", reason="transport response requires independent readback")

PersistentMockSession.observe_target.source:
def observe_target(self, target_key, *, observation_id, read_fault=None):
        self._key(target_key)
        if read_fault not in READ_FAULTS:
            reject("INVALID_FAULT", "unknown target read fault")
        timed_out = read_fault == "timeout"
        if timed_out:
            time.sleep(2.0)
        with self._connect() as db:
            db.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
            if db.execute("SELECT 1 FROM observations WHERE observation_id=?", (observation_id,)).fetchone():
                reject("OBSERVATION_ID_CONFLICT", "observation identity is permanently used")
            value = PublicRecord(format_version="a03-target-observation-1", origin="SYNTHETIC",
                                 provenance="SYNTHETIC", execution_mode="SIMULATED", observation_id=observation_id,
                                 store_id=self.descriptor.store_id, target_store_id=self.descriptor.store_id,
                                 target_session_id=self.descriptor.target_session_id, target_key=copy.deepcopy(target_key),
                                 scope_id=self.descriptor.fixed_scope_id, source_ref=copy.deepcopy(self.descriptor.fixed_source_ref),
                                 observed_at=_utc(), read_sequence=None, target_state_version=None,
                                 target_state_hash=None, read_status="UNAVAILABLE", relevant_scope_completeness=False,
                                 scope_complete=False, view=None, state=None, effect_log=[])
            if read_fault not in ("unavailable", "timeout"):
                state = self._load(db)
                state["read_sequence"] += 1
                self._save(db, state)
                view = self._view(state)
                effects = [json.loads(row[0]) for row in db.execute("SELECT body FROM effects ORDER BY sequence")]
                value.update(read_sequence=state["read_sequence"], target_state_version="a03-target-epoch-" + str(state["epoch"]),
                             target_state_hash=self._hash(state), read_status="OK", relevant_scope_completeness=True,
                             scope_complete=True, view=view, state=copy.deepcopy(view), effect_log=effects)
                if read_fault == "contradictory":
                    value["read_status"] = "CONTRADICTORY"
                elif read_fault == "truncated":
                    value.update(read_status="TRUNCATED", relevant_scope_completeness=False, scope_complete=False)
                elif read_fault == "duplicate":
                    if value["view"]["target"]["questions"]:
                        value["view"]["target"]["questions"].append(copy.deepcopy(value["view"]["target"]["questions"][0]))
                    else:
                        value.update(read_status="TRUNCATED", relevant_scope_completeness=False, scope_complete=False)
            if timed_out:
                value["failure_code"] = "TARGET_READ_TIMEOUT"
            db.execute("INSERT INTO observations VALUES(?,?)", (observation_id, encoded(value)))
        resource = _write_resource(self.asset_root, value)
        value.update(resource=resource, readback=resource, asset_root=str(self.asset_root))
        value["effect_log_resource"] = _write_resource(self.asset_root, {"origin": "SYNTHETIC", "effect_log": value["effect_log"]})
        return value
